name: blindrelay
description: Send transactional email and manage sending domains, OTLP observability, and suppression via Blindrelay — a zero-content EU email relay. Cursor-optimized entry: set BLINDRELAY_API_KEY once under Plugins → Configure; no manual header editing.

BLINDRELAY_API_KEY.title: Blindrelay API key (PAT, optional)
BLINDRELAY_API_KEY.description: Optional. Only for the PAT server (api-pat). Leave empty and enable the OAuth `blindrelay` server for Connect. Same `br_…` keys as the Keys UI. Never both servers at once with an empty key.

BLINDRELAY_MCP_URL.title: OAuth MCP URL
BLINDRELAY_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP on the OAuth host. Default production: https://api.blindrelay.app/mcp

BLINDRELAY_MCP_PAT_URL.title: PAT MCP URL
BLINDRELAY_MCP_PAT_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP on the PAT host. Default production: https://api-pat.blindrelay.app/mcp
